messages:
incident-bot: RESOLVED — Incident INC-2345: Serving tier overload causing elevated 5xx rates. Pager cleared at 14:12 UTC. Root cause investigation in progress. Please use this thread for post-incident coordination and customer comms.

david (oncall): thanks — confirming I handed off to maria for RCA work. tagging support/account for customer-facing plan. @kevin @sam

maria (sre): I pulled logs and traces. Short summary for now: a config change to the autoscaler made last week caused burst throttling when a sudden batch of dedicated requests hit a hot partition. Quick mitigation was to roll back the autoscaler change and restore additional capacity.

kevin (support): customer impact update: 3 enterprise customers saw degraded responses between 13:05–14:09 UTC. No data exfiltration. I've flagged their accounts and started drafting a status note. Need the RCA bullets to finalize language.

lee (prod-ops): action item: add conservative autoscale safety cap and add canary traffic percentage for config rollouts. I'll own the rollout guard. Added to backlog: OPS-1129.

anuj (eng): can we get the exact config diff that caused the change? I want to add tests to prevent this class of misconfig. Maria, can you attach the commit hash?

maria (sre): commit: 9f3b1ac — changed autoscaler policy from p95->p99 CPU to p99->p100 burst detection. That made the scaler delay shedding load and push requests into queue causing KV-cache pressure. I'll paste the minimal repro logs.

maria (sre): ```
# excerpt from autoscaler logs
2026-03-15T13:03:56Z INFO policy eval p100 triggered for pool/gpu-a
2026-03-15T13:04:02Z WARN queueing requests: inflight=324 backlog=88
2026-03-15T13:04:35Z ERROR token-server: downstream timeout -> 504
```

david (oncall): good repro. For the postmortem, I'd like: timeline, root cause, contributing factors, immediate mitigations, long-term fix, owners, and ETA. Let's schedule PM with stakeholders. Availability: maria/lee tomorrow 09:00 UTC works for me.

sam (acct-exec): we need a customer-friendly RCA. Proposal: short incident summary, customer impact window, root cause (in plain language), actions taken, what we're doing to prevent recurrence, and offer a follow-up call. Drafting language below — feedback pls:

sam (acct-exec): "Between 13:05–14:09 UTC on 2026-03-15, some requests to the Redwood Dedicated service experienced elevated errors and latency. The issue was caused by a recent autoscaler configuration change which delayed shedding excess load on a partition, creating a short overload. We reverted the change and restored capacity; service is back to normal. We're implementing safer rollout guards and adding automated canaries to prevent regression. Your account team will follow up with specific impact details."

kevin (support): small edits: mention no customer data was affected, and offer a timeline for the full RCA doc (e.g., 48 business hours). Also add contact point: support@redwood.ai or your AM.

sam (acct-exec): updated: included data safety line and ETA: full RCA in 48 hours. Will send to affected customers after PM confirms technical wording.

trustbot: Suggestion: include a short status page update now and follow up with a link to RCA doc when ready. Template:

```markdown
Incident INC-2345 — Resolved
Status: Resolved
Impact: Elevated errors and latency for some Dedicated customers between 13:05–14:09 UTC.
Root cause (short): Autoscaler rollout increased sensitivity to burst patterns resulting in delayed scaling on a partition.
Next steps: Rollback applied, conservative rollout guard and canary traffic to be implemented. Full RCA in 48 hours.
```

lee (prod-ops): I'll publish that to status page (drafted) after we lock the timeline and the "next steps" language. Will also attach ops ticket links.

maria (sre): Ownership notes for PM: RCA doc (maria), long-term fix (anuj + eng infra), rollout guard (lee), customer comms copy (sam + kevin). I'll write the technical appendix with traces and the commit diff.

anuj (eng): timeline for long-term fix: prototype tests & CI checks for autoscaler policy by EOD next week, full rollout with canaries in 3 weeks. I'll put an RFC + checklist in the repo.

david (oncall): scheduling: let's meet tomorrow 09:00 UTC for the postmortem. I'll post calendar invite and include support and AMs. Action owners, put status in the ticket OPS-1129 and PM-678.

kevin (support): once PM confirms wording, I will send personalized emails to affected customers and update the support cases. I'll include the status page link and offer a call.

sam (acct-exec): note: for customers with SLA implications, propose a goodwill credit. Need approvals from finance: @lee please advise.

lee (prod-ops): agree to evaluate credits after RCA. Looping in finance next.

maria (sre): immediate runbook updates: add quick rollback step for autoscaler changes, and a checklist to validate burst scenarios on canary before rollout. I'll open playbook PR today.

david (oncall): postmortem checklist reminder: add RACI, detection & alert tunables, and test coverage sections. Also record the Slack thread excerpt into the postmortem doc for timeline fidelity.

trustbot: Recommendation: after RCA is published, offer a short webinar or office hours for affected enterprise customers to walk through mitigation and questions. Good for trust rebuilding.

sam (acct-exec): love that. I'll propose times in the follow-up email.

maria (sre): closing notes: final RCA draft targeted in 48 hours (by 2026-03-17 14:00 UTC). Postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Action items assigned in OPS-1129, PM-678, ENG-2045. Will ping here when draft is ready for review.

david (oncall): thanks all — great coordination. Marking thread as the official post-incident coordination channel. If anything else pops up, reply here.
